material.acceptance_criteria: After the server process restarts, the open page re-attaches its mod watch and resumes polling without a page reload, and the failure count resets.
material.description: After the server process restarts, the open page re-attaches its mod watch and resumes polling without a page reload, and the failure count resets.
material.resolution: The browser watch retries dropped polls with bounded backoff (1 s to 8 s, five failures then give up), re-reads the mod version on resume, and logs one reconnect line. CI restarts oscraftd while the page is open and asserts the version resumes. Caveat: dropped polls retry without an attempt cap, so the watch keeps trying at the 8 s ceiling.
material.subject: Browser mod watch stops for good after a server restart instead of re-attaching
material.witness: ci-status run 38915699897 for ed454a37dac5310d4c16d12534f5a58a2f9f8ff0; job browser-reconnect 117022468093
material.witness_plan: Browser ci.yml job kills and restarts oscraftd, then asserts data-mod-version advances again. Evidence: rust/crates/web/site/main.js:322-327 returns permanently after MOD_MAX_FAILURES failed polls with no retry or reattach.

note: The browser watch retries dropped polls with bounded backoff (1 s to 8 s, five failures then give up), re-reads the mod version on resume, and logs one reconnect line. CI restarts oscraftd while the page is open and asserts the version resumes. Caveat: dropped polls retry without an attempt cap, so the watch keeps trying at the 8 s ceiling.
